headline: Not fixed: campus firewall blocks acm.org, awaiting admin approval
text: acm.org wouldn't load from a campus laptop. Uni found its own firewall deliberately dropping all traffic to acm.org's network, and refused to lift the block without admin approval. The owner was told; acm.org stays unreachable from campus until admins act, though no actual admin notification was visible.
